resources.string: Your phone and server must be on the same local network, and the server address must resolve to a local IP. For a public domain, you can set up a local DNS entry on your router.
Keep the entire library, lyrics, artwork, vectors and server-prepared mixes on this phone. Original audio quality. Automatic sync over the local Wi-Fi or Ethernet network, including on battery.
Server rejected %1$d changes. Your action log is retained.
Sign in to the server again to resume synchronization. Your offline library is still available.
Synchronize pending actions before switching the account or server.
Wait for synchronization to stop before switching the account or server.
Failed to download %1$d tracks. Resume synchronization to retry.

Music, lyrics and artwork are stored inside Caimack. Server deletions remove synchronized copies. Turning sync off keeps completed downloads. Offline radio contains up to 100 tracks and stops when the queue ends.
